cues.text: January 2026. Mayon rises to Alert Level 3.
cues.phonemes: dʒˈænjuːˌɛɹi twˈɛnti twˈɛntisˈɪks. mɑːjˈoʊn ɹˈaɪzᵻz tʊ ɐlˈɜːt lˈɛvəl θɹˈiː.

cues.text: A family in the danger zone packs one bag and asks one question.
cues.phonemes: ɐ fˈæmɪli ɪnðə dˈeɪndʒɚ zˈoʊn pˈæks wˈʌn bˈæɡ ænd ˈæsks wˈʌn kwˈɛstʃən.

cues.text: Where do we go, and will there be room for Lola?
cues.phonemes: wˌɛɹ dˈuː wiː ɡˈoʊ, ænd wɪl ðɛɹbˈiː ɹˈuːm fɔːɹ lˈoʊlə?

cues.text: The nearest shelter is a school, and it is already full.
cues.phonemes: ðə nˌɪɹɪst ʃˈɛltɚɹ ɪz ɐ skˈuːl, ænd ɪɾ ɪz ɔːlɹˌɛdi fˈʊl.

cues.text: Zoom out to the whole province.
cues.phonemes: zˈuːm ˈaʊt tə ðə hˈoʊl pɹˈɑːvɪns.

cues.text: In January, four schools turned into evacuation centers, and 3,424 learners were affected.
cues.phonemes: ɪn dʒˈænjuːˌɛɹi, fˈɔːɹ skˈuːlz tˈɜːnd ˌɪntʊ ɪvˌækjuːˈeɪʃən sˈɛntɚz, ænd θɹˈiː θˈaʊzənd fˈɔːɹhˈʌndɹɪd twˈɛnti fˈɔːɹ lˈɜːnɚz wɜːɹ ɐfˈɛktᵻd.

cues.text: By May, 34 classrooms in Camalig were sheltering about 1,315 people.
cues.phonemes: baɪ mˈeɪ, θˈɜːɾi fˈɔːɹ klˈæsɹuːmz ɪn kɑːmˈɑːlɪɡ wɜː ʃˈɛltɚɹɪŋ ɐbˌaʊt wˈʌn θˈaʊzənd θɹˈiːhˈʌndɹɪd fˈɪftiːn pˈiːpəl.

cues.text: Sustainable Development Goal 4 asks for safe places to learn. Goal 11 asks us to protect people from disasters.
cues.phonemes: səstˈeɪnəbəl dɪvˈɛləpmənt ɡˈoʊl fˈɔːɹ ˈæsks fɔːɹ sˈeɪf plˈeɪsᵻz tə lˈɜːn. ɡˈoʊl ɪlˈɛvən ˈæsks ˌʌs tə pɹətˈɛkt pˈiːpəl fɹʌm dɪzˈæstɚz.

cues.text: In Albay, both goals meet in the same classroom.
cues.phonemes: ɪn ɑːlbˈaɪ, bˈoʊθ ɡˈoʊlz mˈiːt ɪnðə sˈeɪm klˈæsɹuːm.

cues.text: Then the alert rises, and minutes start to matter.
cues.phonemes: ðˈɛn ðɪ ɐlˈɜːt ɹˈaɪzᵻz, ænd mˈɪnɪts stˈɑːɹt tə mˈæɾɚ.

cues.text: Heavy rain sends lahar down the river channels and closes the bridges.
cues.phonemes: hˈɛvi ɹˈeɪn sˈɛndz lˈɑːhɑːɹ dˌaʊn ðə ɹˈɪvɚ tʃˈænəlz ænd klˈoʊzᵻz ðə bɹˈɪdʒᵻz.

cues.text: Send everyone to the nearest site, and families arrive at shelters that are already full.
cues.phonemes: sˈɛnd ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn tə ðə nˌɪɹɪst sˈaɪt, ænd fˈæmɪliz ɚɹˈaɪv æt ʃˈɛltɚz ðæt ɑːɹ ɔːlɹˌɛdi fˈʊl.

cues.text: So how do we shelter everyone, the vulnerable first, while keeping the most classrooms open?
cues.phonemes: sˌoʊ hˌaʊ dˈuː wiː ʃˈɛltɚɹ ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn, ðə vˈʌlnɚɹəbəl fˈɜːst, wˌaɪl kˈiːpɪŋ ðə mˈoʊst klˈæsɹuːmz ˈoʊpən?

cues.text: This is where MCS comes into play.
cues.phonemes: ðɪs ɪz wˌɛɹ ˈɛm sˈiː ˈɛs kˈʌmz ˌɪntʊ plˈeɪ.

cues.text: Mathematics turns open data into a road graph, with travel times, capacities, and shelters in three tiers.
cues.phonemes: mˌæθɪmˈæɾɪks tˈɜːnz ˈoʊpən dˈeɪɾə ˌɪntʊ ɐ ɹˈoʊd ɡɹˈæf, wɪð tɹˈævəl tˈaɪmz, kəpˈæsᵻɾiz, ænd ʃˈɛltɚz ɪn θɹˈiː tˈɪɹz.

cues.text: The law's order becomes one lexicographic minimum-cost flow: vulnerable first, then everyone, then classrooms last.
cues.phonemes: ðə lˈɔːz ˈɔːɹdɚ bɪkˌʌmz wˈʌn lˌɛksɪkəɡɹˈæfɪk mˈɪnɪməmkˈɔst flˈoʊ: vˈʌlnɚɹəbəl fˈɜːst, ðˈɛn ˈɛvɹɪwˌʌn, ðˈɛn klˈæsɹuːmz lˈæst.

cues.text: Computing solves it exactly in seconds, and a time-expanded network gives the exact clearance time.
cues.phonemes: kəmpjˈuːɾɪŋ sˈɑːlvz ɪɾ ɛɡzˈæktli ɪn sˈɛkəndz, ænd ɐ tˈaɪmɛkspˈændᵻd nˈɛtwɜːk ɡˈɪvz ðɪ ɛɡzˈækt klˈɪɹəns tˈaɪm.

cues.text: Optimisation sites new Ligtas Pinoy Centers, and the greedy rule is guaranteed at least sixty-three percent of the best.
cues.phonemes: ˌɑːptɪməzˈeɪʃən sˈaɪts nˈuː lˈɪɡtɑːs pɪnˈɔɪ sˈɛntɚz, ænd ðə ɡɹˈiːdi ɹˈuːl ɪz ɡˌæɹəntˈiːd æt lˈiːst sˈɪkstiθɹˈiː pɚsˈɛnt ʌvðə bˈɛst.

cues.text: On the test network, the plan closes fourteen classrooms instead of forty, for under two minutes more travel.
cues.phonemes: ɔnðə tˈɛst nˈɛtwɜːk, ðə plˈæn klˈoʊzᵻz fˈɔːɹtiːn klˈæsɹuːmz ɪnstˈɛd ʌv fˈɔːɹɾi, fɔːɹ ˌʌndɚ tˈuː mˈɪnɪts mˈɔːɹ tɹˈævəl.

cues.text: Ten results, proven, then verified against independent code.
cues.phonemes: tˈɛn ɹɪzˈʌlts, pɹˈuːvən, ðˈɛn vˈɛɹᵻfˌaɪd ɐɡˈɛnst ˌɪndᵻpˈɛndənt kˈoʊd.

cues.text: LIGTA-S will not build one more shelter.
cues.phonemes: lˈɪɡtɑːs wɪl nˌɑːt bˈɪld wˈʌn mˈɔːɹ ʃˈɛltɚ.

cues.text: But when the alert rises, it will tell every family where to go, and keep the most classrooms open.
cues.phonemes: bˌʌt wɛn ðɪ ɐlˈɜːt ɹˈaɪzᵻz, ɪt wɪl tˈɛl ˈɛvɹi fˈæmɪli wˌɛɹ tə ɡˈoʊ, ænd kˈiːp ðə mˈoʊst klˈæsɹuːmz ˈoʊpən.

cues.text: Distance tells you where the shelter is. A plan tells you if there is room, in time.
cues.phonemes: dˈɪstəns tˈɛlz juː wˌɛɹ ðə ʃˈɛltɚɹ ɪz. ɐ plˈæn tˈɛlz juː ɪf ðɛɹ ɪz ɹˈuːm, ɪn tˈaɪm.
